# ============================================================================
# CANDIDATES, NOT SOURCES. Only the REGISTERED section is crawled.
#
# Eightfold tenants recovered by a subdomain-discovery pass (passive DNS and
# URL-index services) and then probed directly against
# https://{slug}.eightfold.ai/api/apply/v2/jobs on 2026-07-28. Unlike the other
# files in this directory, these entries were actually reached, so each one
# records the answer it gave rather than only where the name came from.
#
# The answers, and what each means:
#
#   HTTP 200 with postings  -> registered in internal/services/eightfold.go
#   HTTP 200 with 0 jobs    -> a real board publishing nothing today
#   HTTP 403 + PCSX message -> the tenant gates the list API; see below
#   HTTP 404                -> the subdomain resolves but runs no careers board
#
# The 403s are why this platform was written off in docs/source-backlog.md.
# They answer `{"message": "Not authorized for PCSX"}` to an anonymous client,
# and an earlier pass confirmed that replaying a browser session's cookies,
# CSRF token and Referer does not change it. This pass adds two findings: the
# wall is per-tenant rather than platform-wide, and it depends on neither the
# `domain` query parameter nor the branded careers host — the same slug answers
# the same way through jobs.<employer>.com as through eightfold.ai. Do not
# expect a User-Agent or proxy change to defeat it. The route that does work
# for those tenants is the sitemap at {slug}.eightfold.ai/careers/sitemap.xml
# plus the schema.org JSON-LD on each job page, at roughly one request per
# posting; docs/research/ats-platform-survey.md keeps that deferred behind the
# shared jsonld.go helper it recommends.
#
# 40 slugs are registered in internal/services/eightfold.go as
# EightfoldCompanies: 18 on the list API, and since 2026-07-30 another 22 gated
# tenants on the sitemap + JSON-LD fallback (see the GATED section for the
# measurements and the promotion rules). Adding more means probing them the
# same way and confirming twice, not promoting a name off this list because it
# looks live.
# ============================================================================

# --- Verified, but crawled through SAP SuccessFactors instead ------------------
#
# These three answer the Eightfold list API with postings, and are deliberately
# NOT registered in internal/services/eightfold.go. All three are already
# registered on SuccessFactors, and internal.Dedupe keys on URL, so the same job
# published to both platforms carries two URLs and would be counted twice in
# jobs_record.txt. SuccessFactors wins on both cost and data: one request for a
# whole board against roughly 64 here for Bayer, and a job description this list
# response leaves empty. Counts measured the same day, SuccessFactors first:
# bayer 482/638, fcx 286/289, netapp 281/272.
#
# They stay listed here because they are verified live Eightfold tenants, and
# because that is where to start if the SuccessFactors route ever breaks.

bayer  # Bayer (~638 here, crawled on successfactors)
fcx  # Freeport-McMoRan (~289 here, crawled on successfactors)
netapp  # NetApp (~272 here, crawled on successfactors)

# --- Answered, but published nothing on both runs ---------------------------
#
# Not registered, and not evidence of a dead tenant either: a company that is
# not hiring and a board being wound down look identical from one sample.
# `aexp` is the tenant issue #27 was opened about, and the one case here with
# real evidence of a migration rather than a hiring pause:
# aexp.eightfold.ai/careers now answers HTTP 307 to
# www.americanexpress.com/en-us/careers, so American Express has moved to its
# own careers site since 2022.

aexp
neom
zebra

# --- GATED: HTTP 403, {"message": "Not authorized for PCSX"} ----------------
#
# 109 tenants, the majority of the platform. The list API is closed to all of
# them, but on 2026-07-30 every one was probed at
# https://{slug}.eightfold.ai/careers/sitemap.xml, the route the survey
# proposed around the wall, and the wall does NOT extend to it:
#
#   real     54   a sitemap whose <loc> entries point at the tenant's own
#                 board; 62,982 job URLs across the 54
#   decoy     3   target, kroger and qa serve a byte-identical sitemap listing
#                 EIGHTFOLD'S OWN careers board (app.eightfold.ai?domain=
#                 eightfold.ai, 65 postings). A 200 sitemap is NOT evidence the
#                 tenant publishes one; the adapter checks the loc host and
#                 refuses this shape
#   none     52   404 or no job URLs: genuinely unreachable by either route
#
# The fallback in internal/services/eightfold.go costs ~1 request per posting
# (each job page is fetched for its schema.org JSON-LD block), so registration
# is a per-tenant cost decision made from the measured sitemap size, and three
# rules were applied on 2026-07-30:
#
#   1. the sitemap must be real (54 qualify);
#   2. the job pages must actually carry a JobPosting JSON-LD block -- trimble's
#      do not, on either its branded host or trimble.eightfold.ai (measured:
#      200 with zero ld+json blocks), so trimble stays here despite its real
#      307-URL sitemap;
#   3. the board must be 500 postings or fewer, keeping the route's whole bill
#      at 4,051 requests per crawl across the 22 that qualify. The 15 real
#      sitemaps above 500 -- ericsson (501), deloitte (613, the .de board),
#      sephora (889), astrazeneca (945), elcompanies (1,153), infineon (1,208),
#      lamresearch (1,255), hp (1,286), arcadis (1,347), mc/Mayo Clinic (1,350),
#      morganstanley (1,358), vodafone (1,399), caci (1,646), microsoft (1,739),
#      appliedmaterials (1,775), qualcomm (1,876), eaton (2,248), micron
#      (2,737), citi (3,429), ngc (3,668), starbucks (21,834) -- stay staged
#      until the crawl has budget for them, and several of those names
#      (arcadis, caci, citi, ford, ngc, vodafone, ...) ALSO collide with
#      employers already in the registry on other platforms, so they need a
#      double-count verdict per double_count_test.go before any registration.
#
# Each line below records its sitemap probe. Slugs marked "sitemap OK ... ->
# REGISTERED" moved to EightfoldCompanies; everything else is still gated-only.
